caption: The drawing depicts a single vase placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The vase has a bulbous, rounded body with a narrow, elongated neck that widens at the top into a ruffled, wavy edge. The overall color of the vase is a rich reddish-pink, with a lattice pattern of lighter pink and white crisscrossing over most of the body. The neck of the vase is mostly solid reddish-pink, transitioning to a white interior at the fluted rim. The base of the vase also displays the same lattice pattern, and the shading throughout the drawing provides a sense of dimensionality and highlights to the glass-like appearance of the object.
title: Ornamental Ruby Vase
